verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch's own docs show an official CLI for running API tests from a terminal or an automated system (docs-8, docs-21, docs-31, probe-4). The `hopp test` command generates JUnit reports for collection runs (docs-9), which is the standard way CI systems surface test results. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that failed tests return a non-zero exit code to fail the build, named CI-platform integration examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
